market.question: Will the highest temperature in Chicago be between 56-57°F on May 6?

assessment.reasoning: Chicago May 6 forecast indicates a high near 54°F (early-month cool spell with 54° one of cooler days). 56-57°F band is just slightly above forecast; some chance of upside surprise. Estimate ~18% for the narrow 2°F band.
assessment.key_uncertainty: 2°F bands are narrow; forecast can shift overnight
